3139-5660-6769-6797.easyPrerequisites: Evolution Witness has a +1/+1 counter on it.
3139-5660-6769-6797.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 7 or greater.
3139-5660-6769-6797.description:
Cast The Great Henge by paying {G}{G}. 
When The Great Henge enters, Surge Conductor triggers.
Holding priority, activate The Great Henge by tapping it, adding {G}{G} and causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing The Great Henge, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Resolve the Surge Conductor trigger, causing you to proliferate, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning The Great Henge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat

512-3443-4644.easyPrerequisites: Deathbloom Ritualist and Tidewater Minion do not have summoning sickness.
512-3443-4644.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two creature cards in your graveyard.
512-3443-4644.description:
Activate Deathbloom Ritualist by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Tidewater Minion and Deathbloom Ritualist, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Tidewater Minion ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
512-3443-4644.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Deathbloom Ritualist's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

1981-2415-5686-7399.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-5686-7399.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Bogwater Lumaret triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

997-4871-5220-7806.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
997-4871-5220-7806.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

1619-4605-5542-6139-6798.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-4605-5542-6139-6798.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Caves of Chaos Adventurer from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Caves of Chaos Adventurer enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Caves of Chaos Adventurer.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Caves of Chaos Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Caves of Chaos Adventurer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Caves of Chaos Adventurer token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Caves of Chaos Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Caves of Chaos Adventurer trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-4605-5542-6139-6798.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

1368-5477-6321-7296.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-5477-6321-7296.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

2438-5088-5211-7443-7537.notablePrerequisites:
You control eight or more lands.
Any one opponent cannot block and kill Emeritus of Abundance this turn.
2438-5088-5211-7443-7537.description:
Cast Brass's Bounty by paying {6}{R}, creating at least eight Treasure tokens.
Activate two of those Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding two mana.
Cast a copy of Regrowth from exile by paying {1}{G}, targeting Brass's Bounty.
Pyromancer's Ascension's first ability triggers, allowing you to put a quest counter on it.
Resolve the copy of Regrowth, returning Brass's Bounty from your graveyard to your hand.
Declare Emeritus of Abundance as an attacker.
When Emeritus of Abundance attacks, it triggers, becoming prepared.
During your second main phase, activate your remaining Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding at least six mana.
Cast a copy of Regrowth by paying {1}{G}, targeting the actual Regrowth card.
Pyromancer Ascension's first ability triggers, allowing you to put a quest counter on it.
Resolve the copy of Regrowth, returning Regrowth from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Brass's Bounty by paying {6}{R}.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Brass's Bounty.
Resolve both copies of Brass's Bounty, creating at least sixteen Treasure tokens.
Activate those Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding at least sixteen mana.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Emeritus of Abundance, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast the card Regrowth from your hand by paying {1}{G}, targeting Emeritus of Abundance.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Regrowth and allowing you to target Brass's Bounty with the copy.
Resolve both copies of Regrowth, returning Emeritus of Abundance and Brass's Bounty from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Brass's Bounty by paying its mana cost.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Brass's Bounty.
Resolve both copies of Brass's Bounty, creating at least sixteen Treasure tokens.
Activate those Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding at least sixteen mana.
Cast Emeritus of Abundance by paying {2}{G}.
Cast a copy of Regrowth from exile by paying {1}{G}, targeting Brass's Bounty.
Both of Pyromancer Ascension's abilities trigger.
In response, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Emeritus of Ideation, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve Pyromancer Ascension's first abiliity, putting a redundant quest counter on it if desired.
Resolve Pyromancer Ascension's second ability, copying Regrowth and targeting Emeritus of Abundance with the copy.
Repeat from step 19.

3490-5231-6720-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-5231-6720-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Case of the Uneaten Feast triggers, causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the The Destined White Mage trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

2281-5237-6797.easyPrerequisites: You had a permanent leave the battlefield this turn.
2281-5237-6797.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Renegade Rallier
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Renegade Rallier
When Renegade Rallier dies, Saffi triggers, returning Renegade Rallier from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Renegade Rallier enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

4659-5320-6441.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature or a permanent with a way to sacrifice it.
4659-5320-6441.description:
Use Krark-Clan Ironworks to sacrifice another creature, or sacrifice a permanent by any other method.
Sorcerer's Broom triggers, causing you to pay {3} to create two creature tokens due to Elspeth, Storm Slayer.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing the Sorcerer's Broom tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Sorcerer's Broom triggers twice, and each Sorcerer's Broom token triggers once.
Resolve all but one trigger, choosing not to pay.
Resolve the final trigger, causing you to pay {3} to create two creature tokens.
Repeat from step 3.
4659-5320-6441.notes: If you sacrifice a creature to start using Krark-Clan Ironworks, the starting cost is reduced to {1}. You can instead use a permanent that can sacrifice itself (like a Treasure token) or another method to sacrifice a permanent (like Braids, Arisen Nightmare).

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more +1/+1 counters on it
with two or more loyalty counters on it

2762-4094-4659.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Thopter Squadron's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two 1/1 Thopter artifact creature tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Thopter, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Thopter Squadron's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing the Thopter, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.

1453-2387-3490-7076.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
1453-2387-3490-7076.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on a creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token that enters with a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to Arwen's toughness.
Animation Module triggers. Holding priority, activate the Servo by tapping it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token that enters with a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to Arwen's toughness.
Repeat from step 3.

141-5147-6933.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-5147-6933.description:
Cast Incarnation Technique by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Incarnation Technique.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Incarnation Technique, with the copy targeting Naru Meha
Resolve the Incarnation Technique copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

222-527-5231-5295.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {B}{G}{G}.
Activate Thermopod twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee, adding {R}{R}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: is a creature without summoning sickness

478-527-539--111.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 4 or greater.
478-527-539--111.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {3}{G}.
Activate Candelabra of Tawnos by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping it and Selvala.
Repeat.

261-3490-4050-6283.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to gain life.
You have a nonland card on top of your library.
261-3490-4050-6283.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Suture Priest indestructible.
261-3490-4050-6283.description:
Gain life.
Amalia triggers, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Suture Priest triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Amalia triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding one mana of any color.
Resolve the Amalia trigger, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Repeat from step 3.

1115-3358-4881.description:
During your upkeep, activate Hell's Caretaker by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Activated Sleeper from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Hell's Caretaker.
Activate Activated Sleeper by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Hell's Caretaker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2556-4872-6122.notablePrerequisites: {1}{U} available plus enough mana to cast Time Warp and Mnemonic Wall each turn.
2556-4872-6122.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Mnemonic Wall by paying its mana cost.
When Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Dour Port-Mage by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, returning Mnemonic Wall from the battlefield to your hand.
Dour Port-Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

204-392-1858-2056-2079.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one white permanent.
204-392-1858-2056-2079.description:
Cast View from Above by paying {1}{U}.
Birgi and Saheeli trigger.
Resolve the Birgi trigger, adding {R}.
Resolve the Saheeli trigger, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve View from Above, returning it to your hand.
Activate the Servo by tapping it, adding {U} that can only be spent to cast an instant or sorcery spell, or to gain a Class level.
Repeat.

180-905-4417.description:
Activate Hex Parasite by paying {B/P}, targeting a creature an opponent controls.
Horobi triggers, destroying that creature.
When the creature dies, Sangromancer's first ability triggers, causing you to gain 3 life.
Repeat.
You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

3138-4124-4306.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to green is at least five.
3138-4124-4306.description:
Activate Nyx Lotus by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Whip Silk by paying {G}, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Cast Whip Silk by paying {G}, targeting any creature.
Malachite Talisman triggers, causing you to pay {3} to untap Nyx Lotus.
Repeat.
If your devotion to green is at least six, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may then target any other permanent using Malachite Talisman's ability.

2173-3180-5220.description:
Cast Chamber Sentry either from your hand by paying {0} or from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Chamber Sentry enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Mortuary triggers, putting Chamber Sentry from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

581-2232-2661.notablePrerequisites:
You control a nontoken nonartifact creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
Gwenna does not have summoning sickness.
Your life total is twelve or less.
581-2232-2661.description:
Activate Gwenna by tapping it, adding {1}{B} that can only be spent to cast creature spells or to activate abilities of creature cards.
Cast Death's Shadow by paying {B}.
Gwenna triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and untapping it.
When Death's Shadow enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning another nontoken nonartifact creature that can be cast using one colored mana from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Death's Shadow from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1558-1932-5228.notablePrerequisites: Descent into Avernus has at least four descent counters on it.
1558-1932-5228.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Descent into Avernus triggers, putting two descent counters on it, then causing each player to create a number of Treasure tokens equal to the number of descent counters on Descent into Avernus, and causing each opponent to be dealt an amount of damage equal to the number of descent counters on Descent into Avernus.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five Treasures, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1483-2034-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Weaponcraft Enthusiast, adding {C}{C}.
Weaponcraft Enthusiast dies, triggering Nim Deathmantle, causing you to pay {4} to return Weaponcraft Enthusiast from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Weaponcraft Enthusiast enters the battlefield, creating two 1/1 Servo creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

182-1738.notablePrerequisites: You have the highest life total or are tied for the highest life total.
182-1738.description:
Activate Jarad by paying {1}{B}{G} and sacrificing Serra Avatar, causing each opponent to lose life equal to Serra Avatar's power.
Each opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

1737-2637-4659-4840-4853.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three other nontoken artifact creatures and/or nontoken Vehicles.
1737-2637-4659-4840-4853.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Mechtitan Core.
Activate the Mechtitan Core token by paying {5} and exiling it, Myr Battlesphere, and any three other nontoken artifact creatures and/or nontoken Vehicles, creating a 10/10 Mechtitan creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Mechtitan token, adding {C}{C}.
The Mechtitan token dies, triggering Dross Scorpion and Mechtitan Core.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Prototype Portal.
Resolve the Mechtitan Core token trigger, returning all other cards exiled by it to the battlefield tapped.
Myr Battlesphere enters the battlefield, creating four 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks three times by sacrificing three Myr tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Dross Scorpion triggers three times, allowing you to untap up to three artifacts you control.
Repeat.

92-2749-3779.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is greater than each opponent's.
Note: you may halve the life total requirement for each additional {1}{W}{B} available, repeating step 1 additional times.
92-2749-3779.description:
Activate Vizkopa Guildmage's second ability by paying {1}{W}{B}, creating a delayed triggered ability.
Activate Wall of Blood's ability multiple times by paying 1 life each time until you are at 1 life, giving Wall of Blood +1/+1 until end of turn for each activation.
Cast Swords to Plowshares by paying {W}, exiling Wall of Blood and gaining life equal to its power.
The delayed triggered ability from Vizkopa Guildmage triggers, causing each opponent to lose that much life.
